name: END_30_AREA_WHITE_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). One line: END 55 D, baseline 130 (chain 130/70) -> top 75, ink 131 from x 25 (131 and 187 are the Series D widths at 55, confirming the sheet's '55 D' is END / AREA and its '80 D' the ring numeral); black ring outer dia 180 (R90), ring 15 (inner R75), centre x 272 (chain 25/131/26/180/26/187/25 = 600), centre y 100; 30 80 D centred in the ring (60/80/60 -> top 60); AREA 55 D ink 187 from x 388. Single value 30 (sheet title 'End 30 Area', register: refer to R4-13).
